conbody.p: Covering the rear bumper around the rear corner radar or sensor with foreign materials, such as snow or rain, or installing a trailer or carrier can reduce the detecting performance, resulting in Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist temporarily limited or disabled.
At this time, the warning message and the Master warning light () are displayed on the cluster display, but it is not a failure of Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist.
Warning message: Driver assistance system limited. Radar blocked.
Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist will operate properly when such foreign material or trailer, etc., is removed, and then the vehicle is restarted.

If Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist does not operate properly after it is removed, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

li.p: Even though the warning message does not appear on the cluster, Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist may not properly operate.

Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist may not properly operate in an area (for example, open terrain) where any objects are not detected right after the vehicle is turned on, or when the detecting sensor is blocked with foreign material right after the vehicle is turned on.

note.p: Turn off Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist to install or remove a trailer, carrier, or another attachment. Turn on Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist when finished.
You can check it in the service message of the utility information view of the cluster display window.
